Ava C: Afternoon async — onboarding parachute-curation-v2. Ran smoke evals for longform-coherence and format checks. Quick TL;DR: most prompts green but two failures (one hallucination, one formatting). I'm leaving details and next steps below. :eyes:

Max K: Which prompts failed? IDs plz.

Ava C: prompt_337 — denies anchor facts, hallucinated date. prompt_412 — dropped trailing newline causing JSON parse fail for structured output.

Ava C: Eval snippet:
```
$ ./tools/run_eval --model parachute-v2 --suite longform-coherence --subset smoke
PASS: 48/50
FAIL: prompt_337 (hallucination)
FAIL: prompt_412 (formatting/json-parse)
```

Priya S: I'll take prompt_337. ETA today afternoon. @Ava C can you drop the full trace / example output?

Ava C: copying minimal trace below (removed PII):
```
prompt_337 input: "When was the Redstone launch?"
expected: "1958-..."
model: "parachute-v2"
output: "Redstone launched in 1983."  <-- wrong year, hallucinated extra event
```

Jorge L: Noted. I also saw a small kv-cache regression on the dedicated infra that sometimes changes tokenization for longctx. Seen in integration-run-21. Might relate to quantization switch on the runtime. Raising ticket.

Nora B: Quick ping — PR #8423 (prompt-normalizer) is ready for review. Also have a tiny lint fix needed in eval harness: trailing whitespace in runner.py

CI Bot: deploy/canary build failed for parachute-v2 (stage: canary). Log excerpt: "ValueError: invalid JSON at line 1" — link: https://ci.redwood/5792468000/build

Ava C: OK — Priya, take prompt_337. @Max, can you triage prompt_412 formatting (maybe normalizer PR fixes it)? Jorge, please paste the integration-run-21 logs when you have them. I'll hold the rollout until fixes land; we'll re-run smoke evals after PR merge. Thanks :thumbsup:

Max K: On it — will open small PR to add trailing-newline sanitizer.

Priya S: grabbing the case now.
